title: Psalm 23 Crossword Puzzle — The Lord Is My Shepherd
heading: The Psalm 23 Crossword
description: A Psalm 23 Bible crossword: green pastures, still waters, and the valley of the shadow. Solve the Shepherd's Psalm in a crossword, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Green pastures, still waters, a table spread in the presence of foes — Psalm 23 may be the best-loved chapter in the Bible, and The Lord Is My Shepherd turns its images into clues. If you know the psalm, the answers will rise up line by line as you read the grid.

For more from David's pen there's King David and the mini The Shepherd's Psalm; The Good Shepherd carries the image into John 10. Like every puzzle, it ends on the verse itself: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

clues.text: What anoints the head in the psalm
What the soul-restoring streams are made of
Low place of the shadow of death
Spread before me in the presence of foes

verseText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want
